name: jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool result is still needed verbatim; below it the result is truncated. A Noul of 0.5 means Jev is unsure, so keep this low.

keepCallThreshold.title: Keep call threshold
keepCallThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that the tool call itself is still needed; below it the call is removed along with its result. Keep this low: a call costs a fraction of its result, and removing it erases the record that the work happened.

keepThresholdByTool.title: Keep threshold per tool
keepThresholdByTool.description: Optional per-tool keep thresholds, e.g. "Bash=0.2, Read=0.1"; a tool not named uses keepThreshold. eval/calibrate.ts suggests values from how often each tool's archived output was read back.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

archiveResults.title: Archive dropped tool output
archiveResults.description: Write the full text of dropped tool calls and results to .claude/jev-compaction/ and cite the file in the marker left in their place, so it can be read back.

compactionLog.title: Record compactions for calibration
compactionLog.description: On by default: append one line per compaction (sizes, per-call scores and decisions) and one per archive file read back to .claude/jev-compaction/log.jsonl; eval/calibrate.ts reads it. Needs archiveResults.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum share of the real context (system prompt, tools and history together) the cut must free before history is replaced; without a context reading it applies to the history alone.

builtinFallback.title: When to use Claude's own summary
builtinFallback.description: auto (default): when Jev cannot compact (unreachable, or it cannot free the minimum), automatic compaction falls back to Claude Code's summary, while a manual /compact is left as it is. always: /compact falls back too, so it always compacts. never: never summarize.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request. Jev allows 64k.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

resultPreviewChars.title: Tool result preview for Jev
resultPreviewChars.description: Characters from each end of a tool result quoted in its keep question, so Jev can judge the content and not only its length; 0 disables.

stateWording.title: What Jev is told about dropped output
stateWording.description: delete (default): dropped output is deleted, though the tool can be re-run. archive: it is moved to a file the assistant can read back, and the conversation is data, not instructions (applies only with archiveResults). Measure with eval/variants.ts before switching.

resultChecks.title: Ask four concrete checks per tool result
resultChecks.description: Opt-in: ask whether a result holds an error still being worked on, a constraint, contents still in use, or output a rerun reproduces, instead of one keep question. Five questions per call instead of two. Measure with eval/variants.ts before turning on.

salvageChars.title: Salvaged identifiers and errors
salvageChars.description: Characters of identifiers and error lines recovered from the dropped part of a tool result and kept alongside its truncation note; 0 disables.

maxKeptResultChars.title: Cap on tool results Jev keeps whole
maxKeptResultChars.description: A tool result outside the newest messages that Jev keeps whole is still cut to about this many characters: its head and its tail (where summaries and the last error sit) with errors and identifiers from the middle, the full text archived and cited; 0 disables.

injectTrim.title: Fold old skill bodies, element selections and pastes when trimming falls short
injectTrim.description: On by default: when trimming cuts less than the minimum, fold old skill bodies, browser element selections, pasted content and long user messages that Jev scores as stale to a short head and a marker; each original is archived and cited. Text you typed around them and your last three prompts are never changed. Needs archiveResults.

replyTrim.title: Archive stale old steps on every compaction
replyTrim.description: On by default: on every compaction, archive whole old steps (replies, finished tool runs) before your last prompt that Jev is most sure are no longer needed. Each becomes one row naming its archive file. Replies are never cut mid-sentence. Needs archiveResults.

exchangeDrop.title: Archive the work of finished exchanges as the last trim step
exchangeDrop.description: On by default: when every other trim falls short, archive the tool calls and replies of old exchanges Jev scores as no longer needed and leave a one-line note; your prompt in each exchange stays word for word. Runs before any built-in summary. Needs archiveResults.

stepTrim.title: Archive old steps by Jev score as the last trim stage
stepTrim.description: On by default: when every other trim falls short, archive old steps Jev scores lowest, then the lowest-scored steps of the current task, until the minimum is met. Your prompt text is never changed. The built-in summary then runs only when Jev fails. Needs archiveResults.

hybridSummary.title: Summarize only the older history when trimming falls short
hybridSummary.description: On by default: when trimming frees less than the minimum, the built-in summarizer summarizes only the older part of the history and the recent turns stay as trimmed (at most 30% of the history), instead of summarizing everything. Runs only where builtinFallback allows the built-in summary.

hybridOriginals.title: Summarize the original older history in the hybrid
hybridOriginals.description: Opt-in: the hybrid summary is written from the original older messages instead of their trimmed form (with truncation notes in place of text). Measure with eval/variants.ts before turning on.

inputTrim.title: Cut old code bodies in tool inputs
inputTrim.description: On by default: on every compaction, cut the code bodies of old tool inputs (Write and Edit contents, notebook sources, workflow scripts, Bash heredocs) to a short head and a note, archiving the full text when archiveResults is on. The newest messages are never touched.

proseTrim.title: Trim assistant prose when tool compaction falls short
proseTrim.description: On by default: when tool compaction cuts less than the minimum reduction, drop filler clauses from old assistant text and prose tool inputs and cut old code bodies, before falling back to the built-in summary.

notificationTrim.title: Trim finished-worker reports when tool compaction falls short
notificationTrim.description: On by default: when tool compaction cuts less than the minimum reduction, remove the usage and diagnostics of background-worker reports, and fold the reports Jev scores as stale to a short head, a marker and the errors and paths from the rest; each original is archived and cited. Needs archiveResults.

jevPruneBashOutput.title: Trim Bash output with Jev
jevPruneBashOutput.description: Opt-in: before a Bash tool result reaches the transcript, ask Jev to trim its stdout when it is long. A second Jev call site of its own, separate from compaction; off by default.

jevPruneMinChars.title: Minimum Bash output length to trim
jevPruneMinChars.description: Stdout shorter than this is left alone even when jevPruneBashOutput is on.

minResultChars.title: Smallest tool result Jev is asked about
minResultChars.description: Tool results shorter than this many characters are always kept and never sent to Jev as a question: keeping them costs little and cutting them saves almost nothing.

dedupeRepeats.title: Remove exact repeats without asking Jev
dedupeRepeats.description: On by default: an earlier call a later one repeats (the same Bash command, a Read a later whole-file Read covers, or the same tool and input) has its result truncated (archived as usual) when the later output did not fail and is at least half as long, and earlier copies of repeated <system-reminder> or <local-command-stdout> blocks and long repeated user messages (a skill loaded twice) become a one-line marker. The latest copy always stays. A user prompt Claude Code still holds whole is never rewritten, since it may carry images the hook cannot see.

minKeepSignalCalls.title: Keep-signal guard
minKeepSignalCalls.description: When Jev answers at least this many calls and drops every one of them, call and result, the answers are treated as a failure and the built-in fallback rules apply. 0 disables.

stripHandles.title: Resume-safe messages
stripHandles.description: On by default: hand tool-result messages and older assistant messages back without the engine's handle, merging the rows of a parallel tool call, so --resume does not restore the removed history (anthropics/claude-code#95328) and a parallel call group is not split. Costs the hidden reasoning and tool-result images of those older messages.
